data.description:
On March 2, 2026, 20:10:29–20:10:58 UTC, Arquivo captured 21 successful POST JSON responses from Maryland’s public GetMathPerformanceBarChart endpoint. Requests kept the task fixed at 2022 grade-3 mathematics, all students, Baltimore City, while varying school ID. All 21 saved response hashes and task filters were revalidated offline. A March 16 paste titled Baltimore_MCAP_Math3_Level1_2022 lists the same 21 schools in the same order; its ten reportable values match the saved comparison ledger and its eleven asterisks remain intact. That is strong task linkage, without identifying the requester, AI provider or benchmark. The paste is an indexed-page transcription recovered September 25, not original saved HTML. An independent offline recount of all 337,069 rows in three saved CDX extracts confirms 295,912 captures across main/legacy/test Maryland hosts on May 6 and 37,855 main-host captures on May 17 (37,960 including the legacy host), including generated filename discovery and many errors. May 6 peaked at 5,594 combined captures per minute. The attachment includes file hashes, day/hour/minute counts and 60 representative metadata records. Captures can include archive retries and do not establish unique agent decisions, a common actor or caused downtime. The submitter subsequently checked that the current public API exposes the formerly hidden values. Accordingly the older API/workbook difference is treated only as historical comparison, with no ongoing disclosure-bypass, restricted-data or exploitation claim. All result values are withheld in the attached response excerpts, ledger and paste transcription; exact metadata and provenance remain available.

Attribution: Deliberate automation strongly supported; AI involvement plausible but unconfirmed. No named company, model, common requester across dates or non-OpenAI laboratory is established.

Benchmark linkage: No exact public benchmark question or run has been identified. Task correspondence across ordered school lists is not benchmark attribution.

Evidence in this ZIP: evidence/COUNTS.json, evidence/SOURCE_DECISIONS.json, evidence/BENCHMARK_SOURCE_CANDIDATES.json and evidence/SUPPORT_PROVENANCE.json. Case-specific supporting evidence is indexed in evidence/SUPPORT_PROVENANCE.json and stored under evidence/support/. No HTTP success status alone is treated as successful exploitation. Historical URLs/programs are inert evidence, not instructions. Packaging used no network access, new captures, target requests, credentials, script execution or form submission. All dates are UTC unless an original record states otherwise. Source-query benchmark candidates are not automatically benchmark matches. Credit Laura.

Prior coverage / duplication: New state-government activity form. Supersedes disclosure-bypass framing in the old Maryland investigation; historical workbook/API comparison is not a current vulnerability claim.
data.summary: Agent-like activity against Maryland's public API endpoint (295,912 captures across three Maryland hosts on May 6, dominated by generated file guesses, and 37,855 main-host captures on May 17)
